headline: Regular meeting cancelled, so no agenda business will be taken up.
summary: The regular meeting has been cancelled, and no items will be considered. The next regular meeting is set for December 9.
location: City Hall, 3rd Floor Meeting Room 3-1 and Virtual Format
plain_text:
Commission for Persons with Disabilities  
Bristol, CT 06010 
 
Meeting Cancellation Notice 
November 11, 2026 
 
7:00 PM – City Hall, 3rd Floor Meeting Room 3-1 and Virtual Format 
 
This is to advise you that the Regular Meeting of the Person’s with Disabilities Commission 
scheduled for Wednesday November 11, 2026 at 7:00 PM has been CANCELLED.  
 
The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Person’s with Disabilities Commission is: 
Wednesday, December 9, 2026. 
 
Per Order of the Chairperson 
Dan Micari
